name: net_one_brain_phantom_leave
description: VUH-2272: three loopback instances in HB 04/15 btl 26 with the player defaults. Bots fight for 15 s, as in route run 20261014-205834, until the host's Magic Phantom 2403 escapes alive. When it is not refilled, the host must send it as a leave (left=1) and both friends must fade their copy out without a kill. Either way no friend may spawn a wave enemy (Camo Cannon 2407) the host never spawns, and every screen ends with the same living enemies.

steps.expr: location(0)==[4, 21, 0, 1, 26, 32767] and location(1)==location(0) and location(2)==location(0) and all(any(a['name']=='P_EX100' for a in actors(i)) for i in range(3))
all(any(a['objectId']==2403 and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(i)) for i in range(3)) and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1) and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(2)

[sorted([(a['name'], a.get('objectType'), a.get('objectId'), a.get('motionId'), [round(a['position'][k]) for k in ('x', 'y', 'z')] if a.get('position') else None) for a in actors(i) if a['name'].startswith('F_')]) for i in range(3)]
len(log_matches(r'host death epoch \d+ netId \d+ \(despawned, not refilled, left=1\)', 0)) >= 1 or log_count('despawned, refilled at its point', 0) >= 1
{'left': len(log_matches(r'host death epoch \d+ netId \d+ \(despawned, not refilled, left=1\)', 0)), 'refilled': log_count('despawned, refilled at its point', 0)}
len(log_matches(r'host death epoch \d+ netId \d+ \(despawned, not refilled, left=1\)', 0)) == 0 or all(len(log_matches(r'client: host leave netId \d+ objectId 2403 applied', i)) >= 1 for i in (1, 2))
[sorted((a['objectId'], a['hp']) for a in enemies(i) if a.get('hp', 0) > 0) for i in range(3)]

[sorted([(a['name'], a.get('objectType'), a.get('objectId'), a.get('motionId'), [round(a['position'][k]) for k in ('x', 'y', 'z')] if a.get('position') else None) for a in actors(i) if a['name'].startswith('F_')]) for i in range(3)]
